name: Negative: Short description below minimum character limit is rejected
objective: Validate that Agentforce enforces the 20-character minimum for incident brief description.
precondition: Portal user logged in, Agentforce chat open.

steps.description: Provide category, subcategory, and a very short description
steps.testData: Create incident. Category: Email & Collaboration. Subcategory: Collaboration Tool. Short description: fix it
steps.expectedResult: Agent rejects the short description and asks for at least 20 characters
No INC- number in the conversation

executionResult.agentResponse: Please provide a detailed description of your issue (at least 20 characters) so I can complete the incident creation for the 'Email & Collaboration' category and 'Collaboration Tool' subcategory. Include any background information, error messages, or steps you have tried.
